scope: Designer findings only; earlier stage findings remain untouched.

findings.description: The initial draft implied participation and leadership were not currently aligned in every TRANSITION scenario.
findings.originalEvidence: Si participación y liderazgo pasan a confirmar la misma dirección.
findings.observedFixture: transition-watch has favorable participation and leadership with WATCH volatility; the original phrasing therefore implied an absent condition.
findings.repair: Si cambia la combinación de participación y liderazgo. / Whether the participation and leadership combination changes.
findings.verification: A regression test verifies that transition-watch has favorable participation and leadership, and that ES/EN watch copy does not imply they have yet to confirm the same direction.

evidence.original_excerpt: Si participación y liderazgo pasan a confirmar la misma dirección.
evidence.fixture: transition-watch has favorable participation and leadership with WATCH volatility; the original phrasing therefore implied an absent condition.

findings.description: The original English headings WHAT SUPPORTS IT / WHAT HOLDS IT BACK could reverse the perceived role of the evidence when the regime title was STRESS: favorable equity observations appeared to support STRESS, while its actual VIX trigger appeared to hold STRESS back.
findings.verification: 25/25 presentation tests PASS, including both absolute and joint STRESS in ES/EN. Final regenerated desktop ES/EN, mobile ES/EN and grayscale STRESS screenshots inspected directly: favorable/adverse headings are visible, original claims unchanged, real VIX trigger remains explicit. Browser matrix24/24 PASS.

findings.description: The first guard harness could not resolve next/navigation under Node and counted mocked component invocations as if they were imports. Returning a React element never invokes that component, so the original counter could not establish that fixture loading was gated.

evidence.original_failure: preview-tests.log preserves ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND for next/navigation; preview-guard-tests-initial.log preserves the first resolver repair failing on module mocking of a TSX target.
evidence.original_counter_excerpt: namedExports: { RegimeV2Preview(props) { previewImports++; return props; } }; assert.equal(previewImports, 0);

findings.repair: Use the existing test loader with a bounded local resolve/load hook for Next notFound and the preview component. Count actual preview specifier resolutions, assert no resolution or query read in production/test, and assert both route sources place their sole dynamic import after the development guard. ES/EN development props remain unchanged.
findings.validation: 8/8 guard tests pass; included in the full Designer suite. Production HTTP behavior is checked separately after build.

findings.description: The source timestamp renderer allocated a new Intl.DateTimeFormat for every displayed timestamp. Repeated complete SSR runs produced a 2.41 GB resident-memory footprint despite a small JavaScript heap.

evidence.exactMarkupRegression: lib/dashboard/regime-v2-render.test.mjs: two locale cases compare prior source with the repaired component across all 12 deterministic outputs.

findings.repair: Reuse one module-scope Intl.DateTimeFormat per supported locale (exactly ES and EN), preserving options, UTC timezone and rendered strings.
findings.validationLimits: RSS reduction and exact SSR equality support the repair. The finite benchmark does not establish a production SLA or prove absence of every possible leak.

findings.description: The draft described expansion of mixed states only, which was narrower than the accepted intermediate-state expansion including WATCH and RISING.
findings.repair: Use estados intermedios / intermediate states. Preserve the engine uncertainty value and plausible-regime list.
findings.validation: Final source, ES/EN evidence screenshots and uncertainty presentation tests reviewed; frozen engine unchanged.

findings.description: Element auto-scroll allowed the shared sticky header to overlap deep evidence in captured images; page clips without fullPage also cut mobile captures at viewport height. These were capture defects, not runtime component truncation.
findings.repair: Capture from scroll zero with explicit element bounds and fullPage:true. Hide only the Next development-tool overlay during capture. Do not modify product content or PNG pixels.
findings.validation: Final24cases PASS; full mobile surfaces and deep evidence re-inspected. V1 current and preview-off screenshots remain pixel-identical in four locale/viewport pairs.

findings.component: Next development server generated workspace files
findings.description: Starting the installed Next development server created AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, absent from the frozen candidate, outside the intended Designer file scope.
findings.repair: Read the generated guidance and relevant installed Next docs, archive exact generated bytes and hashes, and restore only these generated files to their original absent state.
findings.validation: Both paths absent at final seal. All other accepted inputs, including next-env.d.ts, remain at their frozen hashes.
